Reflections Curation.content: IF no targeted code reconnaissance has occurred, THEN run focused code queries (read_file for Mongo wrapper and health endpoint, list_files for catalogue/mongo-related dirs) to ground decisions in the current implementation.
IF a reflection provides a concrete correct_approach, THEN ensure future amendments are anchored to that approach and tag amendments as accept/rewrite/reject in reasoning.
IF a playbook_amendment is non-null, THEN evaluate it as accept (aligned), rewrite (modify for runtime observability), or reject (duplicate/generic/irrelevant) and document the label in reasoning.
IF reflections contain verified useful_facts, THEN ingest or merge them into System Knowledge; discard only with explicit justification in reasoning.
